method: Independent re-check of PR #144 and of the December 2026 Spanish rows. Each official document was retrieved directly (no secondary source creates or removes a ban); tables were parsed from the official HTML and cross-read. window.to and jurisdiction last_checked/last_verified are not changed: this is not a full-registry or full-jurisdiction review.

pr_144_check.legal_source: Act LXXII of 2026 §3 (Mt. §102(1): 24 Dec public holiday; in force 14 Nov 2026) + Govt. Decree 190/2008 §2(1)(b), §2(2), §2(3)
pr_144_check.exceptions: §5 categories, §4 permits; §2(3): 4 Nov-1 Mar international traffic EURO 3+ exempt
pr_144_check.open_question: OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED (legal interpretation): §2(2) 'első nap 8 órától' - whether the continuous regime from 08:00 on the first day replaces or adds to the §2(1)(b) start (22:00 on 23 Dec). The encoded start (23 Dec 22:00) is the earliest start directly stated by §2(1)(b); an official ÉKM/police notice for Christmas 2026 would settle it. Not changed.
